comment.body:
WOW. OK. DONE, finally.

It was honestly **painful** to listen to you drone on, reading your essay like a droid might on your livestream. Microsoft Zira (use her all the time) sounds more human than did you.

OK, the essay:

Over 2000 words to say: Muslims and Jews are human beings and not all that different. That kind of bloviation is something I admit, as a writer, I’ve never mastered.

Then you took your turn.

Your primary mistake is your failure to recognize that the conflict in Palestine has nothing to do with culture. It has nothing to do with Zionism, for that matter. 

The “state of Israel” was not established by Zionists, but by the British. Anyone who can’t see the experimental sandbox they made Palestine into should really STFU about the subject. 

The experiment? 

Figure out how to refine genocidal invasion and displacement into a methodology – not primarily as a way to geopolitically hijack entire nations of people, but to learn the **psychological** lessons of conquest-free invasion, occupation, displacement, and inevitable extermination so that knowledge can be applied at any level in any arena to capture and purge any population on the planet.

So, you’ve done nothing more than fall for the deflection that is the narrative of the experimenters and participate as another lab rat.

But all that is a side issue. The basic issue is that you've chosen the side of the 2nd most terroristic, genocidal regime in the world, funded and armed by the worst one by a long ways: the United Terrorist States of American which, ever since WWII, has gone around the world waggling its Little Boy and Fat Man balls at everyone.

Those who side with genocidists, support genocidists, fund and arm genocidists, and try to rationalize their genocide (at which I was surprised you did such a poor job, you're usually more credible and convincing) ARE GENOCIDISTS.

You chose it. Be proud of it like Israelis are. Be proud of USrael like almost all Jews around the world are. Be proud of the legacy of genocide and genocidal intent. Be proud of what Zionists have achieved this far. It will make it just that much more certain that what you fear will come upon you -- thanks not to all the evil people and "terrorist groups" in the world that seek your eradication, but thanks to yourselves.

Just for clarification: I am not "antisemitic". The appropriation of "semitic" as solely a Jewish property smacks of exactly the same kind of conceit and hubris as the appropriation of "American" by the Yanks. 35 countries in the Americas, but only people from ONE have the gall and self-congratulatory supremacism to call themselves "Americans"? As has been pointed out many times, genetically and linguistically and historically, Palestinians the people of most Arab countries are FAR more semitic than Israelis are.

I do not bear hatred towards any group of any identification simply because of their identity. 

I hate evil and I hate incorrigible evildoers. 

I don't hate Israelis because they're Israelis. I hate genocidists. It's not my fault that Israelis are committed to genocide. 

I do not hate Zionists because they're Zionists. I hate colonialism. It's not my fault that the UTSA and Zionists and Israelis are committed to colonialism, its genocide, its ethnocide, and its supremacism. 

I don't hate Jews because they are Jews. I hate the propagandists and sympathizers and enablers and supporters of supremacism, colonialism, and genocide. I hate them whether they're Jews or Arabs or Chinese or Russan or "American" or any other identification. 

I hate them for what they want, what they choose, and what they do. In fact, I curse them.

"Identity" is a red herring -- and one of the foremost foisters of the sham of identity are, historically, Jews. 

Growing up I always wondered why Jews had been singled out as a "protected group". I was raised respecting and admiring Israel. When I became a fundamentalist Christian at age 17 (for 22 years following), I was a rabid fan of Israel. But the question remained.

What about the genocides in Russia, China, SE Asia, E. Timor, Rwanda? What made Jews so special? 

Surveying the rationales that have been given, it's quite clear that they were not reasons, but covers. And now, those covers having been pushed well beyond the limits of rationality, it's getting clear why the real reasons needed covers.

content.text: Sorry to bother you, you’re probably busy, but could you take a minute, look at the post quoted below, and respond to this person’s “criticisms” of your material at
https://thereisnopandemic.net/wp-content/uploads/2023/09/2023_09_17_covid_19_vaccine_associated_mortality_in_the_southern_hemisphere.pdf
? I’m sure you’ve dealt with similar objections many times before. If you have a FAQ or something I could refer them to, I’d appreciate the link.

Rancourt’s “17 million” figure is not a peer-reviewed causal estimate — it’s an ecological time-series extrapolation that equates any excess deaths during vaccination rollouts to the vaccines themselves. He explicitly defines a “vaccine-dose fatality rate” by dividing that inferred excess by doses administered and then extrapolates from 17 non-representative countries to the whole world. That method commits the ecological fallacy, ignores major confounders (COVID waves, health-system strain, delayed care, overdoses, heat, etc.), and produces implausible numbers that contradict surveillance and peer-reviewed work (for example, a Lancet modelling study estimated ~19.8 million lives saved in the first year of vaccination). Independent fact-checks and national health agencies have repeatedly shown these excess-death → vaccine attributions are flawed.
The Lancet
https://www.thelancet.com/journals/laninf/article/PIIS1473-3099(22)00320-6/fulltext

Rancourt literally defines a “vaccine-dose fatality rate” as “the ratio of inferred vaccine-induced deaths to vaccine doses delivered” and then extrapolates 17 countries to the entire globe. That’s just assuming excess deaths = vaccine deaths — classic ecological fallacy, no control for COVID waves, healthcare collapse, or other confounders. His math works out to ~1 death per 794 shots, which is wildly inconsistent with surveillance and registries worldwide. By contrast, The Lancet Infectious Diseases estimated vaccines saved ~19.8 million lives in year one (Watson et al. 2022). The “17 million killed” claim collapses under scrutiny.
Thanks man!
